event_summary: Two hands manipulate a translucent decorated sheet in a clear tray containing clear liquid while the sheet bends and changes position.
raw_event_description: A translucent sheet with colored drawings is held by two hands over and partly inside a clear rectangular tray. At the start, the sheet lies diagonally with a curled upper portion and a lower portion near clear liquid in the tray. The left hand holds the left side while the right hand holds the upper-right folded area. Through the sequence, the sheet is pulled and lifted, its surface forms changing folds and wrinkles, and more of the printed white area becomes upright and visible. The clear liquid surface below shows shifting highlights and rippled outlines. By the end, the sheet is more raised and sloped relative to the tray rim, with part of it still near the liquid.

reasons: The hands, sheet, tray, and liquid are visible, but parts of the sheet are folded and partly transparent.
The event is already underway in the first frame.
Reflections and overlapping transparent surfaces obscure some boundaries.
